record.question: State whether the following statements are 'True' or 'False': (a) A govt servant can be reduced in rank to a post not held by him earlier in the cadre (b) An appeal may be allowed against an order of suspension. (c) Officer performing current duties of a post cannot exercise statutory powers under the rules. (d) No order imposing any of the major penalties shall be made except after an inquiry held in the manner provided under Rule 14 of CCS(CCA) Rules, 1965 (e) Suspension order may be extended beyond 3 months, even if within this period memorandum of charges/chargesheet is not served on the govt servant.
record.explanation: True/False responses: (a) True — reduction to a lower post/grade is a permissible major penalty even where the lower post was not previously held in the cadre; (b) True — an order of suspension is appealable under Rule 23 of CCS (CCA) Rules; (c) True — an officer holding current charge cannot exercise statutory powers unless specifically empowered; (d) False — Rule 19 provides exceptions to the ordinary Rule 14 inquiry requirement; (e) True — suspension can be extended after the prescribed review, even when the chargesheet was not served within the initial 90 days. The supplied choices are placeholders, so no option index represents these responses.
